# IMAP high-water filtering keeps a protocol UID role when the member types are clarified

The owned type follow-up labels the current UID, previous highest UID, high-water local and adopted-message parameter as ImapUid. The filter still chooses either UID ordering above the stored boundary or unread/nondeleted state according to mail.imap.filter_on_new; the UUID comment is corrected to UID. Accepted code retains that role. The owned offline stream already has the same active-message identity guards; this type patch does not introduce them. This annotation does not prove independent UID/key storage or a new filtering algorithm.

Scope: IMAP header UID state and filtering.
